summary: Nova Dental's homepage scores 74. It is secure, mobile-ready, has a canonical URL, alt text on every image and over 300 words. The weak spots are all in what searchers and social apps see first: the title is only 18 characters ('Nova Dental | Home'), the meta description runs to 239 characters, there are no Open Graph tags, and the page has two H1 headings.

top_fixes.title: Rewrite the title tag with services and intent
top_fixes.detail: 'Nova Dental | Home' is 18 characters and says nothing about what the practice offers. Use 30-60 characters naming family and cosmetic dentistry, e.g. 'Nova Dental | Family & Cosmetic Dentist'.
top_fixes.impact: Click-through rate and ranking for dentist searches

top_fixes.title: Add Open Graph tags
top_fixes.detail: 0 of 3 required Open Graph tags are present. Add og:title, og:description and an og:image of the reception or team so links shared by patients preview properly.

top_fixes.title: Trim the meta description to 160 characters
top_fixes.detail: At 239 characters the description is truncated in results. Keep the essentials: family and cosmetic care, Invisalign and implants, evening and Saturday hours.

top_fixes.title: Keep a single H1
top_fixes.detail: 'New patients welcome' is a second H1 below the hero H1. Demote it to an H2 so the page has one main heading.
top_fixes.impact: Clear page topic for search engines and screen readers

top_fixes.title: Link each service to its own page
top_fixes.detail: Whitening, Invisalign, implants, children's dentistry and emergency care are one-line bullets. Link each to a detailed page so searches like 'emergency dentist Saturday' land on a focused answer.

rewritten_meta_description: Family and cosmetic dentistry with evening and Saturday hours: check-ups, whitening, Invisalign, implants and same-day emergency care. Book online.
